name: LiveTvAccess
description: Assign an M3U Live TV tuner to each Jellyfin user. Each non-administrator can browse and play only the channels and guide programs belonging to their assigned tuner. Unassigned users receive no Live TV access, while administrators remain unrestricted. Includes a tuner assignment page and compatibility health checks. Set each tuner's simultaneous stream limit to 1 to limit concurrent use. Requires separate playlists with no shared stream URLs.
overview: Per-user M3U tuner access with channel and playback restrictions.

versions.changelog: Expanded plugin description and catalog branding; tuner/access code unchanged.
